title: Business Ownership
text: AI applications must have an identified business owner.

title: Sensitive Information Controls
text: Sensitive or confidential information must not be submitted to an AI system without appropriate controls.

title: Human Oversight
text: AI-generated outputs used for business decisions must have appropriate human oversight.

title: Logging and Monitoring
text: AI applications must maintain appropriate logging and monitoring.

title: Access Controls
text: AI applications must have defined access controls.

title: Third-Party Security Assessment
text: Third-party AI models and services must undergo appropriate security assessment.

title: Intended Use and Limitations
text: AI applications must have documented intended use and limitations.

title: High-Risk AI Review
text: High-risk AI use cases must undergo additional review before deployment.
